trades.reasoning: CLF shows all four confirmation signals (RSI 65.3 bullish zone, MACD bullish crossover with rising histogram, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge) indicating genuine institutional buying rather than noise.

PKX matches the same full multi-signal setup as CLF (RSI 68.6, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge), making it a high-conviction candidate despite the broader market being only mildly positive.

decisions.briefing: Markets were modestly positive today (NASDAQ +0.9%, S&P500 +0.4%) rather than a strong risk-on day, so we stayed selective instead of deploying into every open slot. CLF and PKX were the only candidates showing full multi-signal confirmation (momentum, trend, and volume all aligned), so we used two of our three open slots on those while leaving the rest of our cash in reserve.

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices drifted modestly higher today without any single dominant catalyst, consistent with a steady, low-volatility grind rather than a sharp risk-on rally. Materials and metals names like CLF and PKX stood out with above-average volume, suggesting sector-specific buying interest rather than a market-wide rotation. Without a strong macro trigger (like a Fed announcement or major earnings surprise), most stocks lacked the volume confirmation needed to justify new high-conviction entries today.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤溫和上揚，NASDAQ升0.9%，S&P500升0.4%，但未見明顯的單一催化因素，較像是穩步爬升而非強烈的風險偏好行情。CLF及PKX等原材料與金屬股成交量明顯放大，顯示資金流向個別板塊而非全市場輪動。由於缺乏強力宏觀觸發因素（如聯儲局言論或重大盈利意外），大部分股票未能同時滿足動量與成交量確認條件，故今日僅精選符合完整訊號的標的進場。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means waiting for multiple signals to align — like RSI in a healthy bullish range, a MACD crossover, price above its moving average, and a volume surge — before trusting a stock's upward move. A single bullish signal can be noise, but when four line up together it suggests real buying interest, which is why only CLF and PKX qualified for new buys today.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動量確認是指等待多個訊號同時出現——例如RSI處於健康的上升區間、MACD黃金交叉、股價高於移動平均線，以及成交量放大——才相信股價的上升趨勢。單一的利好訊號可能只是噪音，但當四個訊號同時出現時，往往代表真正的買盤興趣，這正是今日只有CLF和PKX符合進場條件的原因。
